title: Crash in 4.7 during import due to multiple popups being opened at the same time
body:
### Tested versions

- Reproducable in v4.7.stable.official [5b4e0cb0f]
- Non-reproducable in v4.7 debug build, v4.6.2.stable.official [71f334935]

### System information

Godot v4.7.stable - macOS Sonoma (14.8.4) - Multi-window, 2 monitors - Metal (Forward+) - integrated Apple M3 Max (Apple9) - Apple M3 Max (16 threads) - 64.00 GiB memory - CoreAudio (48000 Hz, Surround 7.1)

### Issue description

I'm importing GLTF files from Blender.  If I have the GLTF scene already open in the scene viewer when the GLTF is re-exported, Godot 4.7 will crash.  From the log messages it looks like the issue may be because I get two popups during the import phase:
* GLTF scene on disk has changed: read from disk, or ignore changes
* GLTF importer progress bar

In this short video, I have the GLTF scene already open in the scene viewer.  When I export the file from Blender again, we see both popups, then a crash.

https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/bfce22ad-54e9-4393-96cc-7aac4df6fa20

Now, if I close the GLTF scene tab, and re-export the GLTF file, the import is fine.  Note that we do not get the second popup to read the GLTF file from disk because the GLTF isn't open in the scene editor.

https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/e5a4b69e-c216-4988-8f9d-3329c6b2fbd8

### Debugging
Issue does not present when running debug build of 4.7-stable.

### Steps to reproduce

### Minimal reproduction project (MRP)

No MRP due to simplicity and need for external editing tools.
